landing.promise: See your karma. Grow every day.
landing.sub: Tell Karma about your day in your own words. It gently notes your Punya and Paap and fills two ghadas, so you can reflect and grow.
landing.f1.d: In Gujarati, Hindi or English. Voice is optional; text always works.
landing.f2.d: Every action is scored with a published, explainable rubric. No black box.
landing.f3.d: A short teaching from the Gita or Jain scriptures and one small step for tomorrow.
landing.privacy: Your words are yours. We never store audio, show no ads and use no trackers. You can export or delete everything at any time.

about.title: How Karma scores your day
about.p1: Karma reads what you share and identifies deliberate actions. Each action is labelled Punya (merit) or Paap (a growth area) and given a weight from 1 to 5.
about.p2: Small acts score 1, medium acts 2–3, major acts 4–5. Ordinary routine such as commuting or meals is neutral and not scored.
about.p3: Intention matters. Help given for show scores lower than help given quietly; accidental harm scores lower than deliberate harm.
about.p4: The rubric is versioned (v1) and the AI runs at temperature 0 with a strict schema, so the same words give the same result. The AI never invents verses: teachings come only from a curated list stored in the app.
about.p5: The ghada fills at 50 points per day (week ×7, month ×30). Lifetime uses a log scale. Karma is a mirror for reflection, not a judgment of you. It gives no legal, medical or financial advice.
about.panchang: The tithi shown on Home is computed on your device (Lahiri ayanamsa, amanta months, Gujarati calendar). Adhik months are not marked separately.
